description_en: Queries all endpoints of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的所有连接地址信息
name: DescribeDBInstanceNetInfoForChannel

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26232.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: An internal parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: flag

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint to query. Valid values:

0: a regular endpoint. This is the default value.
1: a read/write splitting endpoint that is assigned after the shared proxy feature is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
查询的连接地址类型：
0（默认）：常规连接地址。
1：共享代理的读写分离地址
parameters.name: db_instance_net_rw_split_type

DBInstanceNetInfo.description_en: The information about the instance connection

Availability.description_en:
The availability of the instance. Valid values:

Unavailable
Available
Availability.description_zh:
可用状态，取值：

Unavailable：不可用。
Available：可用

ConnectionStringType.description_en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid values:

Normal: a regular endpoint
ReadWriteSplitting: a read/write splitting endpoint that is assigned after the shared proxy feature is enabled
ConnectionStringType.description_zh:
连接地址类型，取值：

Normal：普通连接地址。
ReadWriteSplitting：共享代理的读写分离地址

DBInstanceWeight.description_en: The information about read weights to implement read/write splitting after the shared proxy feature is enabled
DBInstanceWeight.description_zh: 共享代理的读写分离权重信息列表

items.description_zh: 共享代理的读写分离权重详情

Availability.description_en:
The availability of the instance. Valid values:

Unavailable
Available
Availability.description_zh:
实例可用状态。返回值：

Unavailable：不可用。
Available：可用

DBInstanceType.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

Master: primary instance
Readonly: read-only instance
DBInstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型。返回值：
Master：主实例。
Readonly：只读实例

DistributionType.description_en:
The policy that is used to assign read weights. This parameter is returned only for a read/write splitting endpoint that is assigned after the shared proxy feature is enabled. Valid values:

Standard: The system automatically allocates read weights to the instance and its read-only instances based on the specifications of the instances.
Custom: You must manually allocate read weights to the instance and its read-only instances
DistributionType.description_zh:
共享代理的读请求分配策略，只在读写分离连接地址返回该参数，取值：

Standard：按规格权重自动分配。
Custom：自定义分配权重

IPAddress.description_en: The IP address of the instance

IPType.description_en:
The network type of the IP address. Valid values:

Public: the Internet
Inner: the classic network
Private: a virtual private cloud (VPC)
IPType.description_zh:
IP地址的网络类型，返回值：

Public：公网。
Inner：经典网络。
Private：专有网络

MaxDelayTime.description_en:
The latency threshold that is allowed for read/write splitting of the shared proxy feature. Unit: seconds.

This parameter is returned only when ConnectionStringType is set to ReadWriteSplitting
MaxDelayTime.description_zh:
共享代理的只读实例延迟阈值，单位：秒。
只在ConnectionStringType为ReadWriteSplitting时返回该参数

Port.description_en: The port number of the instance

securityIPGroup.description_zh: 实例的IP白名单分组列表

Upgradeable.description_en: An internal parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter

VPCId.description_zh: 实例所属的专有网络（VPC）的ID

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch ID of the instance
VSwitchId.description_zh: 实例所属的虚拟交换机（vSwitch）ID

expiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the endpoint of the classic network type. Unit: seconds
expiredTime.description_zh: 实例经典网络地址的有效时间，单位：秒
